    • buildCategoryCheckBoxes

      private Map<javafx.scene.control.CheckBox, Category> buildCategoryCheckBoxes(Item item)
      Creates one checkbox per category, pre-checked if the item already has that category.
      Parameters:
      item - the item whose current categories determine which boxes start checked
      Returns:
      a map from each checkbox to the category it represents, in the same order as categories

    • buildCategoryDialog

      private javafx.scene.control.Dialog<Set<Long>> buildCategoryDialog(Item item, Map<javafx.scene.control.CheckBox, Category> boxes)
      Builds the OK/Cancel dialog for editing an item's categories.
      Parameters:
      item - the item being edited, used for the dialog's header text
      boxes - the category checkboxes to show, mapped to their categories
      Returns:
      a dialog whose result is the set of checked category IDs, or NULL if the user cancels

    • getCheckedCategoryIds

      private Set<Long> getCheckedCategoryIds(Map<javafx.scene.control.CheckBox, Category> boxes)
      Collects the IDs of every category whose checkbox is ticked.
      Parameters:
      boxes - the category checkboxes, mapped to their categories
      Returns:
      the IDs of the checked categories, in checkbox order; empty if none are checked
